summary: Tested MyCareerCopilot security enhancements - Session Management and Audit Logging. All 13 backend tests passed (100%) and all frontend UI tests passed. Sessions endpoint returns correct structure with ip_address, user_agent, is_current flag. Revoke-all-sessions works correctly. Audit logging creates entries for login_success, signup, forgot_password, revoke_all_sessions events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session management and audit logging fully tested. GET /api/auth/sessions returns sessions with ip_address, user_agent, is_current flag. POST /api/auth/revoke-all-sessions deletes all sessions except current. Audit logs created for login_success, signup, forgot_password, revoke_all_sessions, password_reset events. SessionManagement component at bottom of /profile page shows active sessions with 'This device' badge and 'Logout All Devices' button when multiple sessions exist.

GET /api/auth/sessions.details: Returns list of active sessions with ip_address, user_agent, is_current flag, last_active, created_at

POST /api/auth/revoke-all-sessions.details: Deletes all sessions except current, returns revoked count, creates audit log

Audit logging - login_success.details: Login creates 'login_success' entry in audit_logs collection

Audit logging - signup.details: Signup creates 'signup' entry in audit_logs collection

Audit logging - forgot_password.details: Forgot password creates 'forgot_password' entry in audit_logs collection

Audit logging - revoke_all_sessions.details: Revoking sessions creates 'revoke_all_sessions' entry in audit_logs collection

GET /api/admin/audit-logs/types.details: Returns available audit log types for filtering

Frontend - SessionManagement component.details: Component visible at bottom of /profile page with data-testid='session-management'

Frontend - Active Sessions display.details: Shows session count, browser/device info, IP address, last active time

Frontend - This device badge.details: Current session marked with 'This device' badge

Frontend - Logout All Devices button.details: Button visible when multiple sessions exist, has data-testid='revoke-all-sessions-btn'

Multiple sessions support.details: Multiple logins create multiple sessions (no longer deletes old on login)

Current session preserved after revoke.details: Current session remains valid after revoking all other sessions
